root_cause: Public UI components that call fetchCanonicalCorpus directly reject on /api/corpus failure even though a bundled public canonical/public-register snapshot is available. This converts a recoverable backend degradation into empty EVIDENCE SAFETY / unavailable sections.
fix: Make canonical-corpus-client prefer live /api/corpus but fall back read-only to mergePublicRegisterIntoCanon(canonicalCorpusSeed), filtered to visibility=public and requested surface, preserving story order and caller limit.
regression_gate: Test 7 - Keep canonical content distributed when Corpus API fails

nvidia.role: Digital Igor / orchestrator remains additive to content distribution

release_gate: Do not apply to production until the user's explicit deployment-chain command is received.
